_header.Description: Every line the villagers say and every sign's text. Keys are referenced by tools/gen_areas.py (npcs/signs) and checked by its lint; read at runtime by src/core/DialogueData.gd.
_header.Author: Jose-Jorge HERNANDEZ
_header.Format: entry = {name?, pages: [...], once?: [...], flag?, gift?: {item, amount?, flag, pages}}. A gift is handed over on the talk after the first meeting. 'once' is said the first time (then 'flag' is set in GameState.flags); afterwards 'pages'. A page wraps itself to the box; '\n' forces a line break; a page longer than the box continues on the next box. Story lines are a DRAFT until the owner confirms the plot (docs/GDD.md section 2).

tato.name: Tato
once: Joe... is that really you? Come in, come in. These old eyes have waited a long time for that face.
Since you left, Caver spends his nights under the old chapel. The dogs will not go near it. Neither will I.
Rest a while, then see Boni at the shop and Janga across the road. You will need them both.
pages: Caver's guards walk the south road now. The boulders keep them out... for the moment.
If you are hurt, cut the grass and break the pots. The village has always looked after its own.

boni.name: Boni
once: Joe! Welcome home! My shelves are a little bare these days, I'm afraid.
Caver's men take half of every cart that comes up the road. When the roads are safe again, so is my stock!
pages: Gems, Joe! Green is one, blue is five, red is twenty. A hero's pocket money grows in every bush.

janga.name: Janga
once: Joe! I knew you'd come back. Look at you - still carrying that old family shield.
I'm working on something at the forge for you. Give me a little time.
Until then, remember what your father taught us: hold the sword after a swing, then let go for a spin!
pages: Walk off a ledge to hop down. You can't climb back up the same way, so look for a ramp.
Boni sells bombs now. Some rocks around here look cracked... just saying.
It's done! Your father's old boomerang - I mended the edge and balanced it again.
Throw it with the item button. It stuns what it hits and brings back whatever it touches.

villager_woman.name: Marta
pages: The flowers came back this spring. Strange... the ones along the chapel road grew black.

villager_boy.name: Pico
pages: Mister, can you lift pots? Stand in front of one and press the action button. I'm not strong enough yet!

EL PUEBLO
North: the meadow.  West: the woods.
East: the lake.  South: the old road.

West: Boni's Shop.
East: Janga's house.

NORTH MEADOW
Mind the slimes. They hop when you come close.

WEST WOODS
The ledge only goes one way.

EAST LAKE
No swimming. Do not feed the rock-spitters.

SOUTH ROAD
Closed by order of Caver.
No bare hands will move those rocks.
You got the Lantern! Use it to light torches. Each flame costs a little magic.
You got the Boomerang! Equip it in the item menu (I) and throw it with the item button (K).
You got the Bow, and ten arrows! Shoot with the item button. Boni sells more arrows.
You got Bombs! Set one down with the item button and stand back. Cracked rocks won't stop them.
You got arrows!
You got a small key! It opens one locked block.
You got a Piece of Heart! Collect four to make a new heart container.
Your life grew by one heart!
You found gems!
It's locked. A small key would open it.

shop_bombs.name: Boni
pages: Bombs! Five of them for 20 gems. Want them?

shop_arrows.name: Boni
pages: Ten arrows for 15 gems. Want them?

shop_heart_piece.name: Boni
pages: A Piece of Heart. I only have the one... 100 gems. Want it?

shop_thanks.name: Boni
pages: Thank you, Joe!

shop_no_gems.name: Boni
pages: Oh... you don't have enough gems for that.

shop_full.name: Boni
pages: You can't carry any more of those!
You got the Map! Press Tab to see every room of this place.
You got the Compass! The map now shows where the master of this place waits.
You got the Big Key! It opens the big door and the big chest of this place.
You got the Power Glove! Now you can lift heavy rocks. Stand in front of one and press the action button.
You got the first Family Seal! Its violet stone is warm, like a hand on your shoulder.
Two more seals wait somewhere in the valley.
The door is locked. A small key from this place would open it.
A big lock bars the way. It needs this place's Big Key.
The big chest is locked. It needs this place's Big Key.

MOSS SHRINE
The old guardians kept a family seal here.

SOUTH FIELDS
West: the Hollow. East: the Vault.
North-west: the keep. Keep out.

RAM'S HOLLOW
Something big paces down there.

FROST VAULT
The fence was put up for a reason.

CAVER'S KEEP
Three seals open what one man closed.
You got the Dash Boots! Press Shift (or the right stick) to dash. Rubble won't stand in your way.
You got the Fire Rod! Its fireballs burn what ice protects, and light torches from afar.
You got the second Family Seal! It hums when you face the south.
One more seal waits.
You got the third Family Seal! All three are warm now.
Caver's keep cannot keep you out any longer.
Three sockets are carved into the gate. It will open only when all three family seals are set in them.
The three seals blaze in their sockets. With a groan, the gate of Caver's keep opens.

caver_banish.name: Caver
pages: Enough. You fight like your father, boy. He lost, too.
You want my valley? Then see it as I dream it.
Go. Wander my world until it swallows you.

act1_card.name: END OF ACT ONE
pages: Caver's spell tears the valley in two.
Joe falls into the land his enemy dreams:
the Dark World.
To be continued.
Joe wakes on cold ground. The roads are the roads of El Pueblo... but the houses are hollow and the sky is the colour of a bruise.
This is the valley as Caver dreams it.

tato_echo.name: Tato's echo
pages: Use the mirror where the two worlds touch. What is closed here may be open there.
Four doors lead deeper into this dream: darkness, fire, time and the wild. The darkness lies north, past the withered meadow. Take a light.
Joe. Even here, I know your face. I am what is left of Tato in Caver's dream.
Take this. The Moon Mirror shows the waking world. Look into it, and you will stand there - in the same place.
When you are done, step back through the shimmer it leaves, or find a rift.
You got the Moon Mirror! In the Dark World, use it to step into the Light World at the same spot.
The mirror shows only your own face here.
Something solid stands there in the waking world. The mirror throws you back.

HOLLOW PUEBLO
Nothing here remembers you.

UMBRA
North: the Umbral Vale. Keep a light with you.

SILVA
West: the Silva Tangle. The wild has grown pegs across its path.

IGNIS
East: the Cinder Barrens. The lava runs too wide to jump - find a way across.

TEMPUS
West: the Clockwork Wastes. The road there runs through molten time.

DEAD FIELDS
The keep is only a shadow here.

shade_merchant.name: Shade
pages: Gems spend the same in a dream, traveller. Dearer, though. Everything is dearer here.
Magic runs thin in the dark. A bottle of it keeps the shadows honest.

dw_shop_bombs.name: Shade
pages: Five bombs. 30 gems. Want them?

dw_shop_arrows.name: Shade
pages: Ten arrows. 25 gems. Want them?

dw_shop_magic.name: Shade
pages: A bottle of magic - it fills you to the brim. 40 gems. Want it?

dw_shop_thanks.name: Shade
pages: A pleasure. Mind the dark.

dw_shop_no_gems.name: Shade
pages: No gems, no goods. Even in a dream.

dw_shop_full.name: Shade
pages: You are full already. Come back emptier.
The mirror shows only darkness. There is no waking world behind this place.

UMBRA SANCTUM
What lives here hates the light.
You got the Grapple! Shoot it with the item button: it bites into hook posts and pulls you across chasms and water. It stuns what it hits.
You got a dimension crystal!
You got the Crystal of Umbra! Its cold light pushes the dream back a little.
Three more crystals wait in the other lands of the Dark World.
Your magic is full again!

IGNIS FORGE
What burns here never cools. Bring something colder.
You got the Ice Rod! Its bolts (4 magic) freeze enemies solid, and turn lava into a crust you can cross - for a few seconds.
You got the Crystal of Ignis! It burns without heat in your hand.
Two more crystals wait in the Dark World.

CLOCKWORK WASTES
The blocks rise and fall with the broken clock. Wait for your moment.
You got the Hammer! Swing it with the item button: it pounds pegs flat, flips clockwork bugs onto their backs and cracks armour.
You got the Crystal of Tempus! Inside it, a second hand ticks backwards.
One crystal remains.

SILVA TANGLE
The Grove drinks from the river. Mind the snapping flowers.
You got the Flippers! Walk into deep water to swim. No sword while you paddle, but no river stops you now.
You got the Crystal of Silva! Inside it, a seed waits for spring.
All four crystals shine together. Caver's tower can no longer hide.
